title: Introduce locality-aware grace-budget throttler for Dedicated fleet
author: Priya Rao
description: Motivation: Customers running Dedicated fleets in multiple regions observed unfair burst admission across regions when a single global warm pool is exhausted. This causes noisy neighbors in one region to starve another region that is underutilized. We introduce a locality-aware grace-budget throttler that assigns a small ephemeral 'grace budget' per (region, tenant, priority) tuple that allows short microbursts without consuming long-lived commitments. The budget decays over a sliding window and is replenished based on recent sustained throughput and capacity signals. Design: - Per-region ephemeral budget allocation seeded from a configurable fraction of reserved capacity; budgets are orthogonal to tenant reservations. - Budget decay uses exponential decay with configurable half-life to avoid budget hoarding. - Admission checks consult locality budget first, then fall back to existing reservation/fallback paths. - Fastpath preemption: when global contention is high, low-priority budgets are shrunk proactively using a tunable aggression parameter. - Observability: new metrics expose budget size, consumption rate, decay rate, and locale hit/miss ratios. - Safety: budgets cannot increase a tenant's effective commit above a per-tenant ceiling; audit logs recorded for ad-hoc budget grants. Implementation: - New package pkg/throttler/grace_budget.go implements budget lifecycle and decay (test coverage > 90%). - autoscaler/controller.go integrates budget-aware admission in TryAcquireCapacity. - ops config supports per-region policy overrides (configs/ops/region-policies.yaml). - e2e scenario tests under test/e2e/region_grace_budget_test.go simulate cross-region microbursts and validate fairness SLAs. Rollout plan: 1) Deploy behind a feature flag default-disabled in canary region us-west-2. 2) Gather metrics (grace_budget/consumed, grace_budget/hits, grace_budget/decay) for 48h. 3) Gradually enable for additional regions and monitor SLOs. 4) If regressions observed, auto-disable and fall back to previous admission path. Checklist: - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Observability + dashboards - [x] Documentation - [x] Feature flag gate - [x] Release notes entry

review_comments: Evan Martinez (reviewer): Can we quantify the default budget fraction? Also prefer using a decay constant rather than 'half-life' to align with existing metrics. -> Author: Set default to 2% of reserved capacity and added decay_constant field with migration note.

Lina Gomez (reviewer): Add a safety gate to prevent interplay with global warm pool prewarming. -> Author: Added per-region interaction tests and an explicit check preventing budget if warm pool has available warmlets.
Tomislav Novak (approver): Looks safe and well-tested. Added small nits re: logging levels; approved after changes.
release_notes: Introduced a locality-aware ephemeral grace budget for Dedicated fleets to reduce cross-region starvation during short microbursts. Deployable behind feature flag. Observability metrics added under grace_budget/*.
